briefing:
# Pre-meeting briefing: Databricks, 17 November 2026

**Window:** 18 Oct to 17 Nov 2026. All facts come from the search results below. No hires were found.

**Scale and growth**
- Ben Horowitz's essay (27 Oct) says Databricks has a revenue run rate above $7B, growing 80% year over year. Its Lakehouse is above $1.5B (growing over 100%) and Lakebase is above $100M. The figures are not audited and the essay gives no further breakdown. (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people)
- The same essay says agents now send Databricks more queries than people do. (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people)
- Databricks remains private. Its most recent valuation is $190B, and no IPO date or public S-1 had been announced as of October 2026. (https://smartasset.com/investing/databricks-ipo-date-timeline-valuation-and-investment-options)

**Launches and product**
- On 11 Nov, Databricks launched native Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot. Other compatible agents can connect through the Genie One MCP server. (https://www.unite.ai/databricks-launches-native-genie-plugins-for-four-ai-agents)
- On Wednesday 11 Nov, Databricks launched agentic AI tools that continuously analyze business data. The updated Genie assistant runs in the background and makes proactive suggestions. A separate "Ontology" feature scans an organization's data. (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/day-anthropic-office-push-databricks-220704968.html)
- Commvault announced Data Activate for Databricks, which is not yet generally available. Early access is planned for December 2026 in select Azure regions. (https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:a912a3a702a15:0-commvault-cvlt-plans-governed-data-solution-for-databricks-ai)

**Deals and investment**
- On 20 Oct, HP announced it is moving its customer data platform into Databricks, targeting 40% lower costs. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)
- Wire headlines on the same page list "Databricks Plans $3B Investment in Europe and the Middle East" (dated 12 Nov) and "Databricks to Invest More Than $500M in the Netherlands." The results give no body text for either. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)
- A company profile lists acquisitions, but the most recent ones fall outside the window: Panther Labs (1 Jun 2026) and Electric DB (1 Aug 2026). The profile itself is undated. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/7LlnrDq1nEGX)

**Gaps:** The Solutions Review weekly roundup (7 Nov) appeared only as a headline, so it contributed no usable facts. No hires were found in the results.

## Open questions
1. Can Databricks confirm the run-rate figures for the platform and for Lakehouse and Lakebase, and how each is defined?
2. How will the $3B Europe and Middle East commitment and the $500M Netherlands investment be deployed, and what does that mean for our region?
3. What is the timing for general availability of the Genie plugins and governed-data integrations such as Commvault's, and how will agent access be priced?
